title: Meditation vs thinking task
description: EEG recordings from experienced meditation practitioners performing alternating meditation and active thinking blocks. Data were collected at the Meditation Research Institute in Rishikesh, India. The design includes breath-counting and tradition-specific meditation, with a control group performing breath counting in both meditation blocks.
methods_description: Participants completed four blocks: two meditation blocks interspersed with two thinking blocks, with block order counterbalanced across participants. The first meditation block was breath counting for all participants. The second was tradition-specific meditation, or breath counting for the control group. Participants sat with eyes closed in a darkened room, on a blanket on the floor or on a chair.
